verdict.rationale: Docs show some export paths (notes to Google Docs/Sheets, Audio Overviews downloadable, Slide Decks shareable as PDF), but there's no evidence of a comprehensive, open-format export of all notebook data (e.g., sources, chat history, mind maps, full notebook contents) or a bulk 'export everything and leave' / data-portability mechanism like Google Takeout integration. missing for 10: full data export of sources/citations/chat history, bulk notebook export, open-format guarantees (vs proprietary), independent confirmation of a complete data portability path.
